'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Barry Alperstein LS Hoth: North Ridge''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)|Hoth-L-hothnorthridge.gif|label=Hoth: North Ridge}}
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
